summary: Iteration 51 — PRE-PUBLISH DEEP DIAGNOSTIC (fairy wand ritual + wheel retune + audio + broad smoke). All 7 acceptance-criteria groups verified end-to-end. Fairy wand ritual: cover appears with 'Tap the wand' prompt, RARE FATE badge, and exactly 16 mushroom-ring frame; tapping fairy-wand fires reveal (/reveal-fairy.wav plays, onDone fires at 2s, restaurant card underneath revealed). Fairy scratch ritual: rare-fate-scratch-cover mounts with 16 mushroom ring; label 'The fae hid your fate — scratch the ring' is rendered on canvas (fillText, not DOM innerText — verified via source at RevealStage.jsx:192 + ScratchCover.jsx:121). Wheel of Fate: in main deal flow (dark + ff_rare_force=wheel) the wheel-of-fate mounts; tapping wheel-tap-spin (via JS click) transitions hint through 'Round and round it goes…' → 'The wheel has spoken…' within ~5.4s + 1.5s reveal delay, then the reveal card (E2E Test Diner) is unveiled — spin duration matches the retuned 7-turn / 5.4s / power-ease(3.2) curve. /dev/rare demo autospin also completes ('The wheel has spoken…'). NOTE for future testers: Playwright locator.click(force=True) on wheel-tap-spin sometimes does NOT fire React onClick reliably; use `document.querySelector('[data-testid="wheel-tap-spin"]').click()` via page.evaluate — this is a Playwright/React synthetic-event quirk, not an app bug. Rare pool scoping: dark theme with ff_rare_force=wand correctly falls back (Magic 8-Ball appeared) — wand is scoped to fairy only. Normal fairy deal: no rare cover, reveal-line shows magical quote ('An enchantment seals your path.'). Mobile 390x844: zip-input + spin-roulette-button both render. Welcome dialog: theme-welcome-random works and sets a random theme (observed 'tiki'). Admin login (ForkFate!Admin2026) succeeds and shows sponsor manager + feedback data. Footer feedback dialog submits POST /api/feedback → 200. Stats endpoint /api/stats/fates increments from 1667→1668 after POST /api/stats/fate-dealt. Audio 200 check: /fairy-laugh.mp3 (10KB), /shuffle-fairy.wav (1.5MB), /reveal-fairy.wav (459KB), /soul-wail.wav (370KB), /wheel-tick-end.mp3?v=2 (87KB), /shuffle-cafe.wav (1.06MB) — all 200. Console errors during rituals: 0 app-level errors. Only warnings observed: (a) chromestatus 'Blocked call to navigator.vibrate' (browser policy, expected on first load), (b) React DevTools install hint, (c) one 'empty string passed to src' warning on the admin page (cosmetic — an ). No 4xx/5xx during any tested flow. GREENLIGHT for publish.

issues: Cosmetic React warning: an element receives src="" (empty string) causing the browser to reload the page. Non-blocking. Consider guarding: {src ? : null}.

action_items: OPTIONAL: fix empty-string src warning on /admin (cosmetic React warning; no user impact).

OPTIONAL: consider adding wheel-hint state as data-attribute (e.g. data-stage) on [data-testid="wheel-of-fate"] so automation can assert stage without relying on text — Playwright's synthetic-event click on the tap-spin button is flaky; native .click() via JS works fine but a data-stage attribute would harden future tests.
critical_code_review_comments: FairyWand.jsx: cover container still renders in DOM after onDone (animate opacity to 0 leaves the motion.div mounted). This is intentional for the fade-out animation, but external tests checking `[data-testid="fairy-wand-cover"]` count after tap will still see 1. Consider unmounting via AnimatePresence keyed on `casting` to allow cleaner post-condition checks. Not a bug.
WheelOfFate.jsx line 84: reads localStorage.getItem('ff_muted') synchronously per spin — fine, but no try/catch around localStorage (already wrapped in outer try). OK.

ScratchCover.jsx: the fairy label text ('The fae hid your fate — scratch the ring') is drawn to <canvas> only. It is invisible to assistive tech (no aria-label on the canvas). Consider aria-label={label} on the [data-testid={testId}] container for a11y.
Home.jsx still 1500+ lines — repeat comment from iter50: split further if practical.
